name: use-scroll-progress
title: useScrollProgress
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Scroll position as a 0–1 motion value, for the window or for one element.

meta.descriptionEs: La posición del scroll como un valor de 0 a 1, de la ventana o de un elemento.

examples.title: Progreso de scroll
examples.description: La posición del scroll como un valor de 0 a 1.

examples.title: Glosario
examples.description: Los seis términos de scroll, con demos propias.

api.name: container
api.description: Element that scrolls. Omit to track the window.

api.name: offset
api.description: Passed through to motion useScroll. Example: ["start end", "end start"].

api.name: progress / scroll
api.description: progress is 0–1. scroll is the pixel offset. clampUnit guards a raw fraction.

docs: Clean-room. No Motion UI or Motion+ source. The hook wraps motion useScroll. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Reduced motion does not freeze the value: it reports position.
